runtime.title: Runtime status
runtime.note: This page shows the process lifecycle. Check logs for platform login, live connections and messages; use the browser page for browser status.
runtime.description.stopped: No chat process is running. Choose platforms in startup settings.
runtime.description.starting: The server accepted the request and is waiting for the process to start.
runtime.description.running: The process has started. Check logs for platform initialization and connections.
runtime.description.stopping: Stop requested. Waiting for the process to finish cleanup.
runtime.description.failed: The process failed to start or exited unexpectedly. Check logs for details.
runtime.delayed: The process has not exited after 15 seconds. Check logs for details.
browser.title: TTW dedicated browser
browser.intro: Sign in to TikTok in a dedicated Chrome / Edge window. Your profile is retained across server restarts.
browser.note: A connection only means the browser is reachable. Check sign-in or verification in the browser window. You can minimize it to the taskbar; closing it disconnects the browser. The console does not close it automatically.
browser.connected: Browser connected · Check sign-in in the window
error.BROWSER_OPERATION_FAILED: Browser operation failed. Check settings or server logs
error.BROWSER_NOT_FOUND: Chrome / Edge not found. Set BROWSER_EXECUTABLE to its full path
error.BROWSER_START_TIMEOUT: Browser startup timed out. Check the profile lock and debugging port
error.TAB_CLOSED: The tab was closed. Refresh the page
runtime.optionsNote: Select platforms or features. Leave accounts blank to use existing settings. Choices are saved in this browser.
error.RUNTIME_BUSY: The process is already active or stopping
error.INVALID_START_OPTIONS: Check startup options and select at least one platform or feature
runtime.transportNote: Socket: message relay; Bark: push notifications.
runtime.resourcesNote: Samples the chat process every 2 seconds, excluding the server and browser. CPU 100% equals one core; samples older than 10 seconds show —.
traffic.title: Traffic analytics
traffic.heading: 📈 Traffic analytics · Observation mode
traffic.intro: Join events do not measure platform recommendations. Only received events are included; missing periods do not mean there were no viewers.
traffic.chart.viewers: Viewers (grouped by time; gaps remain empty)
traffic.chart.arrivals: Joins and chat (grouped by time; joins vary by platform)
traffic.chart.description: Drag charts horizontally to pan, or use zoom buttons. Click for bucket totals. These actions change only the analysis window, not the layout. Rate mode omits active users.
traffic.chart.gaps: Shaded areas = no data for that interval
traffic.chart.gapsNote: (offline or no samples received), which differs from zero viewers. Chat counts do not apply clip filtering rules.
traffic.history.title: Historical distribution
traffic.history.description: Brighter cells mean higher average viewers during sampled minutes; — means no viewer samples. Select a time slot for details. These are historical observations, not predictions of platform recommendations.
traffic.history.metricsNote: Engagement is summed across sessions. Cumulative audience uses the maximum because viewers can overlap between sessions.
traffic.ranking.title: Best stream start times (historical reference)
traffic.detail.recent: Recent join records within the selected window (up to 200)
traffic.detail.note: Details retain only recent raw events; historical chart aggregates remain available. Empty historical details do not mean there were no joins. Native join events are currently available only for TikTok.
traffic.detail.empty: No join events received (not all platforms provide them; only native TikTok MEMBER events are supported).
traffic.detail.emptyInterval: No join events in this interval.
traffic.updateError: Update failed. Results below are from the previous update and are not current.
traffic.clean.title: 🧹 Clear statistics (remove unwanted data without resetting everything)
traffic.clean.description: Clear a whole day, part of a day, or the last N hours. Charts and history update after deletion. Sessions are selected by their start time; heartbeat records are retained.
traffic.clean.needDate: Choose a date and start/end times first.
traffic.clean.invalidEnd: End time must be after start time.
traffic.clean.speakers: Chatters (by message count; all pages available)
traffic.clean.raw: Raw events (by time; unsaved message content cannot be recovered)
traffic.clean.metricsHidden: Metrics update (values not expanded in this preview)
traffic.clean.retention: Raw events are retained for 7 days. Aggregates remain available for earlier periods; no raw events does not mean there was no data.
traffic.history.error: History failed to load. Displayed results are not current.
traffic.storageNote: Data is saved locally in SQLite and survives restarts. Charts and history use all minute aggregates; live status and join details retain up to 24 hours / 20,000 events. Native TikTok joins/chat and TikTok/Twitch viewer counts are supported; other sources must report explicitly.
traffic.chart.hint: Hover to inspect values; click or tap to pin an interval. Focus a chart and use arrow keys or Home/End to navigate; Esc clears selection.
traffic.chart.viewersLabel: Viewer chart; arrow keys change intervals, Escape clears selection
traffic.chart.arrivalsLabel: Joins and chat chart; arrow keys change intervals, Escape clears selection
traffic.chart.readout: {state}: {from} – {to} · Average viewers {viewers} · Joins {joins} · Chat {chats} · Active chatters {active}
traffic.status.stale: No fresh viewer sample (older than 90 seconds)
traffic.diagnostics: Viewer samples: {observed}/{total} intervals in range · Latest native: {native}, backup: {backup} ({samples} samples / {events} events in memory) · Blocked {blocked}/{chats} messages · Ad accounts {ads}/{active}
traffic.summary: This range has {count} viewer intervals ({minutes} minutes each), recorded even without chat. First and last sampled intervals: {from} – {to}.
traffic.summary.empty: No viewer samples in this range. Expand the range or check daily statistics below.
traffic.clean.previewCounts: {span}: {minutes} minute aggregates, {events} raw events, {chatUsers} chatter records, {sessions} sessions. The following data will be deleted:
traffic.clean.removed: Deleted: {minutes} minute aggregates, {events} raw events, {chatUsers} chatter records, {sessions} sessions ({memory} events remain in memory).
traffic.history.cell: {day} {hour}:00 · {minutes} sampled minutes over {days} days · {joins} joins and {chats} chat events recorded.
traffic.ranking.note: {sessions} sessions across {cells} slots. Ranking requires at least {minimum} sessions across 3 days, a known stream start time, and at least 20 observed minutes in the first 30 minutes. These are historical observations, not platform recommendation rules.
traffic.ranking.insufficient: No time slot meets the requirement of {minimum} sessions across 3 days with a known start time and at least 20 observed opening minutes ({sessions} sessions total). No ranking yet.
traffic.ranking.partial: Not yet qualified (needs {minimum} sessions across 3 days): {list}
traffic.ranking.unstarted: {count} sessions excluded because the source did not provide a stream start time.
traffic.overview.title: All-history overview
traffic.overview.hint: Drag the selection to pan or resize. Arrow keys pan; + / - zoom. You can also choose an observation segment.
traffic.overview.loading: Loading details for the selected period…
traffic.overview.limit: Select at most 366 days at a time.
traffic.overview.restart: Detailed queries require the updated server. Restart the server and reload.
traffic.overview.summary: Detail: {from} – {to} · Average viewers {average} · Highest minute average {peak} · {samples} samples · {minutes} minutes per interval
traffic.overview.gap: Gap since the previous segment: {hours} hours (no data).
traffic.overview.compressedNote: Hatched bands mark compressed gaps with no data. Data segments are widened for selection. Detail charts keep real time; scroll the overview horizontally when needed.
traffic.overview.realNote: The overview uses true time proportions. Hatched bands indicate no data.
traffic.window.note: Blue shows mean viewers across sampled minutes. Brighter green below indicates higher viewer sampling coverage; blank background means no samples. Drag the selection to pan, its edges to resize, or outside to select a new window. Both charts use real time. Thin green marks show the highest minute mean. Detail windows span up to 366 days; the overview covers all data.
traffic.window.quality: Viewer sampling: {observed} minutes · Unsampled: {missing} minutes · Coverage {coverage}% (minute resolution; missing samples are neither zero viewers nor proof of being offline)
traffic.browse.empty: No records in this window. This does not establish whether the stream was offline.
traffic.browse.note: Up to 6 observation segments per page. Select a card or navigate records. A segment is not necessarily a stream session. Only changing Browse mode to Free time range reveals the timeline and zoom controls.
traffic.segments.hint: Each card is an observation segment with records. Select one to view its charts below. Up to 6 per page, newest first.
traffic.design.zone: Inputs and charts use {zone}; maximum 366 days.
traffic.design.invalid: Enter valid, unambiguous local times: end must follow start, not be in the future, and span at most 366 days.
traffic.design.loading: Loading {from} – {to}. Previous results are hidden until complete.
traffic.design.failed: Window failed to load. Charts and statistics are hidden. Select a segment or apply dates to retry.
traffic.design.draft: Date edits are not applied yet. The charts still show the loaded window.
